allocation.method: Same public example transplanted into immutable 0b12da14a control and candidate; both cargo run --locked --release --manifest-path <kernel>/Cargo.toml --example planner_allocations, using kernel opt3/fatLTO/codegen1 profiles. allocation.semantics: allocation_calls includes alloc and alloc_zeroed. A realloc counts its entire new size as requested and old layout size as freed; requested/freed bytes are allocator requests, not resident/peak memory, copied bytes or instructions.
